test_title: PYST 58: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: WGOA is related to XHRB in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, HRBL is related to ISCM. To which of the following is GQAK related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

 
• Each letter shifts **+1** position forward in the English alphabetical order.

Let's verify this logic with the given examples:

**For 'WGOA' related to 'XHRB':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba50cbd10f260bfa5df2af99354754654f33f872f01bfdac722ea0d8bf198c31.png] 

**For 'HRBL' related to 'ISCM':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93f6c9dd43eb4709b86db39c213be565477d72d1f86e53d1eeefa0849c339d0c.png] 

**Applying the assumed logic (+1, +1, +1, +1) to 'GQAK':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/637ac3605afee0e2c49ce01d4627b949ce27dd21061267319e62936d93bba183.png] 

Thus, 'GQAK' will be coded as **HRBL**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
